rationale: Receipt GR-7706 confirms only 60 of 100 EACH delivered, with 40 on backorder, so under clause 4 the payable is calculated on the received quantity: 60 x $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3, no variance). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net gives $42.75, total $612.75; the supplier's $71.25 simply reflects the over-invoiced quantity, not an independent tax error, so only one defect is present and clause 11 escalation is not triggered. Clause 10 places $612.75 with AP_CLERK.
